Drone strikes have hit power stations in southeast Sudan, plunging cities into darkness.

name: Sahel (Mali)
who: Al-Qaeda-linked JNIM and allied fighters vs the military government
what: Jihadist fuel blockade and insurgency threatening the junta
when: Blockade of the capital began around September 2025

current: Mali is on the brink of civil war as Islamist groups such as JNIM and Tuareg rebel factions consolidate control in the north, with attacks more than doubling since the first phase of UN peacekeeper withdrawal in August 2026. Russian paramilitary forces are now fighting alongside Malian troops against al‑Qaeda and IS‑linked militants, while the military government claims a successful counter‑offensive that has killed hundreds of insurgents. Nevertheless, security conditions continue to deteriorate, highlighted by a deadly IS‑Sahel attack on civilian encampments in the Ménaka region that left dozens dead.
